scenes: 03 · Send an NDA, just like today
09 · The deal keeps up with you
10 · Ask the vendor for their insurance
12 · One space for everyone on the deal

steps.title: Cover: Unified Agreements
steps.cue: This is our unified agreements concept.
steps.do: Show the cover card. Hide cursor, clear highlights, reset camera.

steps.title: Fade to All Agreements · mark every deal
steps.do: Fade the cover out. Mark the six deal names [pm=deal-name].

steps.title: Mark what’s in each deal
steps.do: Replace marks with the document/envelope counts [pm=deal-counts].

steps.title: Mark who is involved
steps.do: Replace marks with the whole people/status column on every visible row [.acv-row-people].

steps.title: Highlight Start
steps.cue: eSignature already works great for most users.
steps.do: Clear marks. Highlight the Start button [pm=start-button]; move the cursor onto it.

steps.title: Open Start menu
steps.cue: So we keep it that simple, and make it the front door to the rest of our platform.
steps.do: Click Start. Highlight the open menu [pm=start-menu] (Send an Envelope, New Agreement, New Request, New Purchase Request).

steps.title: Send an Envelope → Signature Request
steps.do: Click “Send an Envelope” [pm=start-send-envelope]. Wait for the Signature Request page [pm=sr-page]. Reset camera.

steps.title: The NDA is already attached
steps.do: Highlight the Non-Disclosure Agreement tile [pm=sr-doc-nda].

steps.title: Type Sam in as the recipient
steps.do: Scroll to Add recipients [pm=sr-recipients]. Click the Name field and type “Sam Sanders”, then the Email field and type “sam.sanders@globex.com” (typed character by character, ~35 ms per character; instant in fast replay). Highlight the recipient block.

steps.title: Next → deal page, sent toast
steps.do: Clear highlight. Click Next [pm=sr-next]. Wait for the deal page [pm=deal-page] in its “sent” state; toast “Your documents were sent for signature.”

steps.title: Back to the list · new top row
steps.cue: The new deal shows up in your list,
steps.do: Click the deal’s back arrow [pm=deal-back]. On All Agreements, highlight the new top row “New Vendor Deal · Sam Sanders · 1 envelope” [pm=deal-row-new-vendor].

steps.title: Mark the row’s status
steps.do: Mark “Waiting for Sam Sanders” on that row [pm=deal-status, New Vendor Deal row].

steps.title: Open the deal · NDA side panel
steps.cue: Click in to see who you’re waiting on,
steps.do: Clear. Click the New Vendor Deal row; wait for the deal page. Click the NDA document card [pm=doc-card-nda]; wait for the side panel [pm=nda-panel]. Highlight its recipients block [pm=nda-recipients] (“Sam Sanders needs to sign”).

steps.title: What’s happened so far
steps.do: Highlight “Sent by you · Yesterday at 10:14 am” [pm=nda-sent-by].

steps.title: Remind Signers
steps.do: Move the cursor to Remind Signers [pm=nda-remind] and highlight it. Don’t click.

steps.title: Close panel · header chips
steps.cue: We also pull out what’s inside your contracts,
steps.do: Clear. Close the side panel. Highlight the header chip strip [pm=deal-chips] (Awaiting Signature · Party Sam Sanders · Expires In 1 year).

steps.title: Key dates
steps.do: Mark “Expires In 1 year” [pm=chip-expires].

steps.title: Party drawer · negotiation history
steps.cue: and your history with this party.
steps.do: Clear. Click the Party chip [pm=chip-party]; wait for the party drawer [pm=party-drawer]. Highlight Negotiation History [pm=party-negotiation].

steps.title: Close drawer
steps.cue: Now imagine a few weeks go by.
steps.do: Clear. Close the drawer, hide cursor, reset camera.

steps.title: Add Documents → file picker → editor
steps.cue: You upload the MSA right into the same deal.
steps.do: Click Add Documents [pm=doc-add]. Wait for the in-app file picker [pm=file-picker] with “New Vendor MSA” preselected; pause 400 ms; click Open [pm=file-open]. Wait for the MSA editor [pm=msa-editor].

steps.title: Zoom to the document
steps.do: Zoom gently onto the document page [pm=msa-page] (max 1.3).

steps.title: Select text · context menu
steps.do: Show a text-selection highlight on “Effective Date: January 15, 2026” [pm=msa-effective-date] and open the context menu [pm=msa-context-menu] (Add comment, Add approval) beside it.

steps.title: Add approval panel
steps.do: Click Add approval. Reset camera. Wait for the Add Approval panel [pm=approval-panel] with Description prefilled “Please approve”. Highlight the panel.

steps.title: Pick Leona → Create Approval
steps.do: Click Add approvers [pm=approval-search], type “le”, wait for results (Leona Legal, Liam Legal), click Leona Legal, click Create Approval [pm=approval-create]. Toast “Approval added to tasks”.

steps.title: Back to the deal · documents side by side
steps.cue: The draft sits next to the NDA,
steps.do: Click the editor back arrow [pm=editor-back]. The deal is now in its drafting state; toast “Your document was added”. Highlight both document cards [pm=doc-card-msa, doc-card-nda].

steps.title: Approval task
steps.do: Highlight the task row “Approve content in New Vendor MSA · Leona Legal · In progress” [pm=task-approve-msa].

steps.title: New milestones
steps.cue: and the milestones move to match where the deal is.
steps.do: Highlight the stage tracker [pm=deal-stages] (Inception · Drafting · Client Review · Legal Review · Signature · Complete, with Drafting current) and the “Drafting MSA” chip.

steps.title: Tasks + menu
steps.do: Clear. Scroll to Tasks [pm=tasks-panel]. Click the Tasks + button [pm=tasks-add]; highlight the menu [pm=tasks-add-menu] (Signature Request, Upload request, Identity verification, New Vendor Onboarding).

steps.title: Upload request → Send
steps.do: Click Upload request. Wait for the Upload request form [pm=upload-form], already filled in. Highlight it briefly, then click Send [pm=upload-send].

steps.title: COI task lands in the list
steps.cue: It lands in the same task list.
steps.do: Toast “Upload request sent out”. Highlight the new top task row “Certificate of Insurance · Sam Sanders · Not started” [pm=task-coi].

steps.title: New Vendor Onboarding → Create task
steps.cue: Ready to onboard them? Start the onboarding workflow right here.
steps.do: Clear. Click Tasks + then New Vendor Onboarding. Wait for the form [pm=onboarding-form], already filled in; highlight it; click Create task [pm=onboarding-create].

steps.title: Onboarding task
steps.do: Toast “Vendor onboarding workflow created”. Highlight the task row “New Vendor Onboarding — Globex Industries · Sam Sanders · Not started · in 7 months” [pm=task-onboarding].

steps.title: Remind
steps.cue: and you can nudge anyone who’s behind.
steps.do: Hover that row so its Remind button [pm=task-onboarding-remind] appears; highlight Remind.

steps.title: Everyone on the deal
steps.cue: Here’s a real strength: everyone on the deal works in one space.
steps.do: Clear hover. Scroll to top. Highlight the participant avatars [pm=deal-participants] and the Messages panel [pm=messages-panel].

steps.title: Open the MSA
steps.do: Clear. Click the MSA document card; wait for the editor.

steps.title: Send for Client Review
steps.cue: Send it to the vendor for review, right from here.
steps.do: Click the Send for Signature caret [pm=editor-send-caret]; click “Send for Client Review”; wait for the modal [pm=client-review-modal] (recipient Sam Sanders prefilled); click Send for Review. Return to the deal; toast “Your document was sent for review”.

steps.title: Cut to the vendor portal
steps.do: Veil-cut (white flash, 300 ms) to the vendor portal [pm=portal], “Welcome, Sam Sanders”. Reset camera, hide cursor.

steps.title: Everything waiting on them
steps.cue: one page with everything waiting on them.
steps.do: Scroll so all four tasks show. Highlight the task list [pm=portal-tasks].

steps.title: Review · Sign · Start · Upload
steps.do: Clear highlight. Mark the four action buttons in order [pm=portal-btn-review, portal-btn-sign, portal-btn-start, portal-btn-upload], each mark appearing 450 ms after the last.

steps.title: Vendor opens the MSA · Suggesting
steps.cue: In the real world, things change.
steps.do: Clear. Click Review [pm=portal-btn-review]; wait for the editor in vendor Suggesting mode [pm=msa-editor-suggesting]. Highlight the “Suggesting” badge.

steps.title: Suggested edit
steps.cue: Suggested edits come right back to you,
steps.do: Show the suggestion: “January 15, 2026” in section 1 struck through and “February 1, 2026” inserted, plus a suggestion card [pm=suggestion-card] by Sam Sanders (Globex). Highlight the card and the edit together.

steps.title: Back on the deal · Edits suggested
steps.do: Veil-cut to the internal deal page. Highlight the MSA card’s “Edits suggested” badge [pm=doc-card-msa-badge] and the task row “Review New Vendor MSA.docx · Sam Sanders · In progress” [pm=task-review-msa].

steps.title: Where we started
steps.cue: We started with simple signature collection.
steps.do: Clear. Highlight the NDA document card [pm=doc-card-nda].

steps.title: The whole agreement
steps.cue: Now it’s one shared space for the whole agreement:
steps.do: Highlight Documents, Tasks and Messages together [pm=docs-panel, tasks-panel, messages-panel].

steps.title: Tasks, workflows, vendor view
steps.do: Highlight the Tasks panel [pm=tasks-panel].

steps.title: Messaging
steps.cue: and down the road, messaging inside and out.
steps.do: Highlight the Messages panel and its composer [pm=messages-panel].

steps.title: Closing
steps.cue: That’s how we believe we drive IAM adoption.
steps.do: Clear all, hide cursor, reset camera, show the closing card.
